_doc: R: per view: reg_dx/reg_dy = registration of the rig render to the m96 master cell (feet rule, rest pose), used for the head hull and texture projection; dx/dy = OUTPUT placement of the sprite in the 128 cell (= reg shifted up by lift_px so stepping soles are not clipped at the cell bottom, round 3); yaw = per-view rig turn (view cheat) used by render_motion.py. The pixel chain uses dx/dy. SW/W/NW (round 4) mirror SE/E/NE: dx -> -dx, yaw -> -yaw; their masters/textures are the horizontally flipped SE/E/NE masters. Round 10: head_yaw_off (deg, extra head yaw toward the camera: SE -10 / SW +10) and head_yaw_limit (E/W/NE/NW 10 deg clamp of the head yaw vs rest) are applied by render_motion.head_cheat() on top of the motion.
